name: Zn-13X-Bench
description: Real multi-resolution synchrotron XCT and XRD-CT pairs with physics-based OpenImpala transport scoring for tomographic super-resolution, chemical fusion, and cross-beamline registration, built on Green et al., Scientific Data 12, 329 (2025).
citeAs: @article{green2025multimodal, title={Three-dimensional, multimodal synchrotron data for machine learning applications}, author={Green, Calum and others}, journal={Scientific Data}, volume={12}, pages={329}, year={2025}, doi={10.1038/s41597-025-04605-9}}

distribution.name: benchmark_splits_v1.json
distribution.description: Leakage-free LR-voxel-buffered T1 axial splits and 4-fold Leave-One-Slice-Out T2 XRD-CT splits.

distribution.name: i13_benchmark_transforms.json
distribution.description: Frozen 7-DOF similarity transforms and ruby-sphere calibrated magnification ratios (1.604x, 2.026x, 2.493x, 5.051x, 8.101x).

distribution.name: tasks.yaml
distribution.description: Formal specifications for Tasks T1, T2, T3, and optional T4, including primary raw_float32 and secondary cleaned_dering_v1 tracks.

recordSet.name: T1: Real-Pair Synchrotron XCT Super-Resolution
recordSet.description: Paired DLS I13-2 float32 sub-volumes across 1.604x, 2.026x, 2.493x, 5.051x, and 8.101x ratios above the ruby shadow, supporting Synthetic-vs-Real training comparisons scored by PSNR, SSIM, 3D FSC, and OpenImpala transport.

recordSet.name: T2: Chemical Super-Resolution and Fusion (4-Fold LOSO)
recordSet.description: 50 um DIAD XRD-CT Na/Zn maps + co-registered 0.54 um DIAD XCT paired with 25 um XRD-CT reference slices at z = 9, 14, 17, 18, scored up to the measured 25 um FRC resolution cutoff (k <= 0.43 cyc/px).

recordSet.name: T3: Cross-Beamline Tomographic Registration (Gated on Stage 0C)
recordSet.description: Unaligned DLS I13-2 (1.625 um) and DLS K11 DIAD (0.54 um) float32 XCT volumes scored against Stage 0C fiducial-verified 7-DOF transform on fiducial TRE, scale recovery, and octant residual drift.

recordSet.name: T4: Sparse-View XRD-CT Reconstruction (Optional Extension)
recordSet.description: Angularly subsampled 25 um XRD-CT sinograms paired with full 40 x 79 reference reconstructions, scored by variance-weighted residual and 2D FRC.
